name: FrontierMath
description: A benchmark of hundreds of original, unpublished mathematical research problems crafted by over 60 expert mathematicians — including a Fields Medalist and 14 IMO gold medalists — spanning most branches of modern mathematics across four difficulty tiers. Problems are verified to require genuine mathematical insight and are kept entirely private to prevent contamination. Endorsed by Terence Tao.
evaluation_method: accuracy (automated verification against provably correct solutions)
typical_sota_score: <40% on Tiers 1–3 (best models as of early 2026); Tier 4 and 16 open research problems remain unsolved
reputation: Most unsaturated math benchmark as of 2026; endorsed by Terence Tao; developed by Epoch AI; widely cited as the definitive test for frontier mathematical reasoning; unprecedented difficulty even for the best models
notes: Problems are kept entirely private and never published, making contamination virtually impossible. Four difficulty tiers ranging from undergraduate-level to open research problems. At launch (November 2024), state-of-the-art models solved under 2%; by early 2026 top models solve over 40% of Tiers 1–3. Tier 4 problems represent genuinely unsolved mathematics. Automated verification uses symbolic computation systems.
